items.t: Angie Nixon campaigns in Central Florida ahead of midterm
items.x: Angie Nixon, the Democratic nominee for Florida's U.S. Senate Seat, campaigned in Kissimmee on Tuesday night, and was joined by U.S. Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez. Nixon hopes to unseat Republican Sen. Ashley Moody.

items.t: Florida deputy faces battery charge after forceful arrest of 67-year-old DUI suspect, sheriff says
items.x: An Osceola County deputy is facing a battery charge after video shows him "using an unnecessary amount of force in handling the arrested suspect," the sheriff's office said.

items.t: 2 more Harmony High School students arrested in mob attack, deputies say
items.x: Two more Harmony High School students have been arrested in connection to a mob attack on another student who stood up for a classmate that was being bullied, according to the Osceola County Sheriff's Office.

items.t: Osceola deputy arrested after alleged excessive force against 67-year-old woman
items.x: Osceola County Deputy Joseph Billittier faces felony charges after supervisors flagged his conduct on body camera footage.

items.t: 'Library of the future': New tech library opens in Osceola County
items.x: A new technology-based library in Osceola County is giving residents and visitors access to tools ranging from 3D printers and laser engravers to artificial intelligence and telehealth equipment.

items.t: Harmony High School attack arrests rise to 11 as more teens face felony charges

items.x: State Attorney Monique Worrell announced the conviction last week, emphasizing that the diamond theft also put Tiffany store employees at risk.

items.t: Husband charged with murder of missing Volusia County teacher Maria Gaminde
items.x: A man faces first-degree murder charges in the death of his wife, Maria Gaminde, a former University High School teacher.

items.t: Iran hasn't tried to repair nuclear facilities damaged in US strikes, UN nuclear chief says
items.x: The head of the U.N. nuclear agency says there's been no indication Iran has tried to repair or reconstruct its nuclear facilities damaged in U.S. and Israeli military strikes this year or last year.
